reason: The cited evidence (E1) only states that HEAs can have simple BCC structures and generally improved properties, without mentioning lattice distortions, dislocation pile-up suppression, or the specific WTaTiVZr alloy. E2 discusses dislocation pile-up mechanics in a different context (annealed material) and does not link lattice distortions to improved ductility in HEAs. Thus, the key mechanistic premises are unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Multi-element HEAs exhibit enhanced lattice distortion due to multiple principal elements.
Lattice distortions impede dislocation pile-up formation and reduce local stress concentrations.
Reduced pile-ups promote uniform dislocation nucleation/motion and delay crack initiation.
Pure tungsten suffers from localized dislocation pile-ups leading to brittle crack propagation.
The WTaTiVZr alloy is a single-phase BCC HEA with these distortion-mediated benefits.
